props.name: startSource
props.comment: The field holding the start of an event; a dotted path reads a nested value.

props.name: endSource
props.comment: The field holding the end. An event with none, or one before its start, covers its start day only.

props.name: titleSource
props.comment: The string field shown as the event title; the record representation otherwise.

props.name: colorSource
props.comment: The field whose value picks a color from `colorMap`.

props.name: views
props.comment:
The views offered. The first one is shown when `defaultView` is not among
them. Default `["month", "week", "agenda"]`.

props.name: perPage
props.comment: How many records one fetch asks for. Default 1000.

props.name: rangeFilter
props.comment:
The list filter that asks for the visible range. By default records whose
`startSource` falls in it: `${startSource}_gte` and `${startSource}_lte`.
With `endSource` set, records that end in it or after it instead:
`${startSource}_lte` and `${endSource}_gte`, which also fetches an event
that starts before the range. A record with an empty end is then left out,
so such data needs a custom `rangeFilter`. The keys it returns replace
those.

props.name: linkType
props.comment:
Where an event links to when nothing listens to `select-event`. `edit` by
default, `show` when the resource has no edit view, and an inert event when
it has neither. `false` leaves events inert.

slots.name: event
slots.comment: Replaces an event in its day cell.

slots.name: header
slots.comment: Replaces the title and the navigation.
